query:
SELECT 
                t.name as topic,
                a.title,
                a.content, 
                authors as "authors: Json<Vec<String>>",
                links as "links: Json<Vec<String>>",
                published_at as "published_at: chrono::DateTime<chrono::Utc>"
            FROM article as a
            JOIN topic as t ON a.topic_id = t.id
            WHERE a.published_at > datetime('now', '-1 days')
